attributes.residual: IMPROVED 75.6587% -> 86.0838% fuzzy (real 162 -> 173 at 167/166 insns, opcode multiset 16t -> 13t), commit 445c62e72. FOUR structural clusters from the banked work order are now CLOSED and confirmed by measurement, and each was a genuine SEMANTIC correction, not a respelling: (a) sAudioMute++ belongs OUTSIDE the sndCmd4 retry loop - the target's two back edges (+0x1e4 ble, +0x1f4 b) both land at +0x1a8, AFTER the increment at +0x1a4, so the previous reconstruction incremented the counter once per retry where the target increments once; (b) queueSlot+1188 is hoisted into a callee-saved home before the loop and copied into r6 per iteration (`mr r6,r24`), which is exactly the 1-instruction deficit the prior session localized; (c) the target really does emit a REDUNDANT second `bge` at +0x1c8 (two consecutive bge on one cmpwi), reproduced by writing the unreachable-but-present `if (resp < 0)` guard around ErrorPrintf; (d) the drain loop is a single-exit for(;;) whose suspend arm assigns 0 to a merge temp and falls into the shared `cmpw expected,cur` test, with the lbl_803442A8/FreeHiMem latch laid out physically BEFORE the body - the previous while-loop-with-two-breaks shape cost one instruction and two clusters. THE ENTIRE REMAINING DEFICIT IS ONE INSTRUCTION AND IT IS PRECISELY NAMED: at +0x70 the target emits an UNFUSED conditional-over-unconditional branch pair `bge ->+0x78` (to the loop latch) followed by `b ->+0x88` (past the `li r29,-1` sentinel), where our object emits the single fused `blt ->+0x84`. FOUR distinct source spellings were measured and ALL FOUR produced byte-identical output: `if (v < 0) goto L;`, `if (v >= 0) continue; goto L;`, `if (v < 0) goto L; else continue;`, and `if (v < 0) goto L; else { }`. The peephole hypothesis is DEAD by inspection, not by probe: cflags_demo already rewrites -O4,p to -O4, so peephole is ALREADY OFF TU-wide and the fusion is MWCC front-end block layout. shapegrep confirms the shape `bge,b,addi,addi,bdnz` occurs in exactly ONE function in the entire target image - AudioLoadPart itself - so there is no byte-exact positive control anywhere to read the spelling off. The loop-construct axis was also spent: rewriting the scan as do/while lost the counted-loop transform entirely (no mtctr/bdnz, 165 insns, multiset back to 16t). DO NOT re-probe branch spelling or loop construct for this cluster. The two remaining count-neutral clusters are the indexed-vs-displaced loads at +0x64 (`add r4,r31,r3`/`lwz 1176(r4)` vs our `addi`/`lwzx`) and +0xc4 (`add r3,r5,r28`/`lwz 28(r3)` vs our `addi`/`lwzx`), both classified unreachable by the direct-global-member law above; plus the allocator-class `addi r3,r29,0` vs `li r3,0` at +0x60 and the whole-function r21-vs-r22 save-set base (target stmw r21, ours stmw r22 - target carries one more callee-saved register).
